items.heading: A Teacher Trainer Is Not
items.text: A teacher trainer is not a bigger version of a classroom teacher. It is a genuinely different job: you spend your day working with adults who already know how to teach, helping them get better at a specific skill, method, curriculum change, or tool.

items.heading: These Are Not Interchangeable Versions
items.text: These are not interchangeable versions of the same job. Entry routes, pay structure, and job security differ sharply across them.

items.heading: Observing Live Classes and Giving
items.text: Observing live classes and giving specific, actionable feedback, not generic praise or criticism.

items.heading: Designing Training Content
items.text: Designing training content: session plans, practice activities, and assessment tools that other trainers or coordinators can also use.

items.heading: Supporting Teachers One
items.text: Supporting teachers one-on-one after a training session, since a single workshop rarely changes classroom practice on its own.

items.heading: Reporting on Training Outcomes, Whether
items.text: Reporting on training outcomes, whether that is a government CPD completion record, a school's internal quality review, or an ed-tech partner-school rollout metric.
